notes.title: Halloween Update + Full Controller Support
notes.content:
Hey guys!!

ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP 1.2 is live now so you can beat the crap out of those bastards with a gamepad now!!

This madness includes:

- Halloween update
- Full controller support
- More bonus levels
- Some gameplay balancing and improvements
- Some bug fixing

And now it is available on Mac too!

We wish you a fartastic experience!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.15 is online + Free Wallpapers + Game Guide :D
notes.content:
Hello!

I hope you are fine! 
Some good news here:

- Updates: Some bug fixing, game balancing and other content has been uploaded!

- Media: You can find free wallpapers and a free game guide to get all the golden plungers!

- Coming soon to the store: Mac and Linux version and the game original soundtrack by Liquid Life Revolution!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
Wath's up guys!
ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP has a major update now that contains:

- Difficulty balancing 

- Items spawning chance

- More bonus levels in-between certain game events

- Baby Mode enhanced for rookie players

- More detailed tutorial about how to use the "LysoGun" after the store

- Translation problems fixed for several languages

- And a lot more!


So, do you think you would be able to defeat those evil poops on Steam?
Let's see...

PS: Mac and Linux version coming soon

PS2: VR version coming not that soon :D
